```{python}
#| label: fig-lattice-waste
#| fig-cap: "The gate waste ratio at 9.9M rows: rows scanned against rows matched for the benchmark point P3"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

labels = ['rows scanned', 'rows matched']
values = [9938375, 1]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5.5, 3.5))
bars = ax.bar(labels, values, color='white', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2, width=0.5)
bars[0].set_hatch('///')

ax.set_yscale('log')
ax.set_ylabel('Rows (log scale)')
ax.grid(axis='y', linestyle=':', alpha=0.4)

ax.text(0, 9938375 * 2.5, '9,938,375', ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(1, 3, '1', ha='center', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax.text(0.5, 5e4, 'waste ratio 9.94M to 1', ha='center', fontsize=9,
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.25', facecolor='white', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.8))

ax.set_title('P3 point query, 9.9M-row table', fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
```
